```{r linear_dendrogram_breast_cancer_k, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=8, dpi=300}
# ==============================================================================
# 1. CARGA DE LIBRERÍAS
# ==============================================================================
library(dplyr)
library(dendextend)

# ==============================================================================
# 2. CARGA Y PREPARACIÓN DE DATOS
# ==============================================================================
df_cancer <- read.csv("breast_cancer_prediction.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

vars_cluster <- c("Age", "BMI", "Tumor_Size_cm", "Blood_Pressure", "Cholesterol")

# Muestra estratificada representativa (5 pacientes por cada estadio tumoral)
set.seed(42)
df_sample <- df_cancer %>%
  filter(!is.na(Cancer_Stage)) %>%
  group_by(Cancer_Stage) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 5) %>%
  ungroup()

# Construcción de etiquetas clínicas informativas
df_sample$Etiqueta <- paste0(
  df_sample$Cancer_Stage, " | ",
  round(df_sample$Tumor_Size_cm, 1), " cm, ",
  df_sample$Age, "a"
)

# ==============================================================================
# 3. ESCALADO Y CLUSTERING JERÁRQUICO (Ward.D2)
# ==============================================================================
matriz_escalada <- scale(df_sample[, vars_cluster])
rownames(matriz_escalada) <- df_sample$Etiqueta

dist_matriz <- dist(matriz_escalada, method = "euclidean")
hc_modelo <- hclust(dist_matriz, method = "ward.D2")

# ==============================================================================
# 4. CONFIGURACIÓN VISUAL HOMOGÉNEA
# ==============================================================================
k_clusters <- 3
colores_k <- c("#09aa64", "#de2c35", "#135ae1") 

dend <- as.dendrogram(hc_modelo)

dend <- dend %>%
  color_branches(k = k_clusters, col = colores_k) %>%
  set("labels_col", "#222222") %>%
  set("branches_lwd", 2.2) %>%
  set("labels_cex", 0.95)

alturas <- sort(hc_modelo$height, decreasing = TRUE)
altura_corte <- mean(c(alturas[k_clusters - 1], alturas[k_clusters]))

# ==============================================================================
# 5. RENDERIZADO DEL DENDROGRAMA
# ==============================================================================
par(family = "sans", mar = c(4.8, 1, 5.5, 16))

plot(
  dend,
  horiz = TRUE,
  main = "",
  xlab = "",
  axes = FALSE
)

# Título principal
title(
  main = "Linear Dendrogram: Agrupación jerárquica de perfiles tumorales en cáncer de mama",
  adj = 0,
  line = 3.0,
  cex.main = 1.25,
  font.main = 2,
  col.main = "#111111"
)

# Subtítulo
mtext(
  "Clasificación por similitud multivariante de características clínicas (método Ward.D2)",
  side = 3,
  line = 1.2,
  adj = 0,
  cex = 0.95,
  font = 1,
  col = "#444444"
)

# Eje X inferior
axis(
  side = 1,
  col = "#cccccc",
  col.axis = "#444444",
  cex.axis = 0.82,
  lwd = 1
)

# Etiqueta del eje X
mtext(
  "Distancia euclídea (variables estandarizadas)",
  side = 1,
  line = 2.8,
  cex = 0.9,
  col = "#222222"
)

# Umbral de corte y etiqueta
abline(v = altura_corte, col = "#444444", lty = 2, lwd = 1.4)
text(
  x = altura_corte,
  y = length(labels(dend)),
  labels = " (k = 3)",
  col = "#444444",
  font = 2,
  cex = 0.85,
  pos = 4,
  xpd = TRUE
)
```

<small style="color: #555;"> **Fuente:** Kaggle. Breast Cancer Prediction Dataset. (<https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/mobeenfatimah/breast-cancer-prediction-dataset-10000-patient>) </small>
